content_zh:
在他消失一瞬间，方正就感觉自己的脚下立刻变成了一片虚空。随后整个人就好像是坐上了一条没有尽头的滑梯般飞快的向下坠落。他甚至分不清楚自己是不是在向下坠落，只感觉自己的四周好像有无数星星在闪烁一般，到处都是一片天旋地转———而紧接着，方正只感觉自己的身体高高飞起。
下一刻，重力便再一次毫不留情的捕获了他的身体。
“砰！！”
再一次重重的摔倒在地上，方正不由的叫出身来，他感觉自己的身体简直就和要散了架一样，全身上下没有一处是完好的。
自己怎么这么倒霉，连续穿越了两次，连续两次被扔到地上？有没有天理王法了？
“方正！！”
就在方正内心腹诽的时候，只见一个男人的声音在他耳边响起，接着方正就感觉有人一把拉住了自己，把他从地面上拉了起来。他睁开眼睛，向着眼前望去，只见一个穿着盔甲的男子正死死的盯着自己。
“你还好吧？有没有受伤？”
“我………我没事。”
虽然不清楚眼前的男子是谁，方正还是摇了摇头，强迫自己清醒过来，这才开口回答道。而听到他的回答，那个男子终于如释重负的松了口气，接着他放开方正，举起手中的长剑。
“快，我们离开这里！该死的亡灵马上就要把我们包围了！如果我们现在不走的话，那么就再也走不掉了！！”
“哎？”
听到男子的说话，方正向着旁边望去，这才发现在瓢泼大雨之中，正有数十个全身溃烂，仿佛电影之中活死人一般的怪物向着他们走来，在他们身边不远处，此刻已经有数个士兵倒在了血泊之中，没有了呼吸。
我了个去，怎么又来？
看着眼前这一幕，方正彻底无语了。系统你是要玩死我？刚重生过来就被人追杀，结果为了躲避追杀，我换了个世界还是被围攻？
不过还好，这次围攻他的不是那些可怕的圣骑士，而是一群活死人………好吧，这其实也好不到哪儿去。
想到这里，方正也是“唰”的抽出霜之哀伤，接着立刻跟随着眼前的男子一同飞快的向着荒野的尽头跑去。那些活死人的速度并不快，但是它们的数量非常多，要不是方正和那个男子跑的快的话，恐怕被包围之后，他们就再也出不来了。
“真是该死！”
直到逃出了包围圈，男子这才用力握紧拳头，在空中一挥。
“真没想到，居然会在教堂附近居然会出现这么多的不死生物！可惜了那些好小伙子………哎，我甚至没办法安葬他们………”

说道这里，男子叹了口气，接着他望了一眼方正。
“好了，我们回崔斯特姆吧，这些该死的亡灵一定会对那里发起进攻的，我们必须要保护好它！”
“我知道了。”
听到男子的命令，方正什么也没有说，只是点了点头。看来在系统任务的世界里，自己的身份已经被系统安排好了。只是到现在为止，他还没有搞清楚这是哪个世界，从那个男子的装扮来看，似乎和自己重生的主世界性质差不多吧。
雨越下越大，方正和那个男人狼狈不堪的，以落汤鸡的姿态回到了被称为崔斯特姆的小镇。这是一座看起来并不怎么大的小镇，镇口的大门紧闭，只有两侧的哨塔上站着两个手握长弓的民兵。当看见两人来到大门前时，哨塔上的卫兵立刻弯弓搭箭，瞄准了方正等人。
“你们是谁？来这里干什么？！”
而面对卫兵的询问，方正身边的男子则是大声喊叫了起来。
“是我！拉姆福德！还有方正！我们回来了！”
“是拉姆福德队长！”
听到这个叫做拉姆福德的男子的声音，哨塔上的卫兵愣了一下，接着立刻招手大喊起来。
“伴随着卫兵的喊叫声，大门缓缓刚刚走进小镇，方正就可以感觉到这里的紧张气氛，瓢泼大雨之下，整座小镇看起来阴森而冷清。而在不远处一个大坑前，还横七竖八的躺着数具民兵的尸体。看见这些尸体，拉姆福德的眉头顿时皱了起来。
“为什么不火化他们？”
“现在雨太大了！队长！”
听到拉姆福德的询问，一个卫兵摸了一把面上的雨水，大声回答道。

content_en:
The moment he disappeared, Fang Zheng felt that his feet immediately turned into a void. Then the whole person fell down quickly as if he were on an endless slide. He couldn't even tell if he was falling downwards. He only felt that there were countless stars twinkling around him, and the world was spinning everywhere - and then, Fang Zheng only felt his body flying high.
The next moment, gravity captured his body mercilessly again.
"Bang!!"
Falling heavily to the ground again, Fang Zheng couldn't help but cry out. He felt as if his body was falling apart, and no part of his body was intact.
Why was he so unlucky that he traveled through time twice in a row and was thrown to the ground twice in a row? Is there any heavenly law?
"Founder!!"
Just as Fang Zheng was cursing in his heart, a man's voice sounded in his ears, and then Fang Zheng felt someone grab him and pull him up from the ground. He opened his eyes and looked in front of him, only to see a man in armor staring at him.
"Are you okay? Are you injured?"
"I...I'm fine."
Although he didn't know who the man in front of him was, Fang Zheng shook his head, forced himself to wake up, and then answered. After hearing his answer, the man finally breathed a sigh of relief. Then he let go of Fang Zheng and raised the long sword in his hand.
"Quick, let's get out of here! The damn undead are about to surround us! If we don't leave now, we'll never be able to leave again!!"
"Huh?"
Hearing the man's words, Fang Zheng looked to the side and realized that in the pouring rain, dozens of monsters with ulcers all over their bodies, like the living dead in the movies, were walking towards them. Not far from them, several soldiers were already lying in a pool of blood, no longer breathing.
I left, why come again?
Looking at the scene in front of him, Fang Zheng was completely speechless. System, are you trying to kill me? I was being hunted as soon as I was reborn. In order to avoid being hunted, did I change the world or was I still besieged?
Fortunately, it was not those terrifying paladins who besieged him this time, but a group of living dead... Well, this was actually not much better.
Thinking of this, Fang Zheng also drew out Frostmourne with a "swish", and then immediately followed the man in front of him and ran quickly towards the end of the wilderness. Those living dead were not fast, but their number was very large. If Fang Zheng and the man hadn't run so fast, they might never have been able to get out after being surrounded.
"Damn it!"
It wasn't until he escaped from the encirclement that the man clenched his fist hard and waved it in the air.
"I never expected that so many undead creatures would appear near the church! What a pity for those good boys... Hey, I can't even bury them..."
After saying this, the man sighed, and then he glanced at Fang Zheng.
"Okay, let's go back to Tristram. These damn undead will definitely attack there. We must protect it!"
"I understand."
After hearing the man's order, Fang Zheng said nothing and just nodded. It seems that in the world of system tasks, my identity has been arranged by the system. It's just that until now, he hasn't figured out which world this is. Judging from the man's clothing, it seems to be similar in nature to the main world in which he was reborn.
The rain became heavier and heavier, and Fang Zheng and the man returned to the small town called Tristram in a state of embarrassment. This is a small town that doesn't look very big. The gate at the entrance of the town is closed, and there are only two militiamen holding longbows standing on the guard towers on both sides. When they saw the two people coming to the gate, the guards on the sentry tower immediately bent their bows.He nocked an arrow and aimed at Fang Zheng and others.
"Who are you? What are you doing here?!"
Facing the guard's questioning, the man next to Fang Zheng shouted loudly.
"It's me! Rumford! And Fang Zheng! We're back!"
"It's Captain Rumford!"
Hearing the voice of the man named Rumford, the guards on the sentry tower were stunned for a moment, and then immediately waved and shouted.
"With the shouts of the guards, the gate slowly entered the town. Fang Zheng could feel the tense atmosphere here. Under the pouring rain, the whole town looked eerie and deserted. In front of a large pit not far away, there were several corpses of militiamen lying scattered. Seeing these corpses, Rumford suddenly frowned.
"Why not cremate them? "
“It’s raining too much now! team leader! "
Upon hearing Rumford's question, a guard touched the rainwater on his face and answered loudly.
